news.title: New: Thrill of the Kill
news.body: Every kill now fuels the next. Each enemy you slay grants a stack of Thrill of the Kill: +1% damage done for 60 seconds, stacking up to 10 times (+10%). Every new kill refreshes the timer, so keep the momentum going! Player kills in PvP count too. Grey-level mobs and critters don't, so no farming rabbits. The launcher installs the client patch automatically; you'll see the buff on your bar after your first kill.

news.title: Welcome
news.body: The launcher keeps your client in sync with the server. Hit Play once it says Ready.
